subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading run)'

question: Should a Feishu-capable owner require a supported-Node reproduction with a full stack and loaded package identities before approving a fix shape?
rationale: The known missing-`inbound` crash is already guarded, while the current report uses unsupported Node 26 and does not identify which shared `.run` surface is undefined.

options.title: Require supported-runtime evidence
options.body: Reproduce on Node 24 and collect a redacted full stack plus resolved plugin/package paths before selecting the repair boundary.

options.title: Investigate Node 26 separately
options.body: Treat Node 26 compatibility as exploratory work without assuming the reported failure is a supported-runtime regression.

recommendation.title: Require supported-runtime evidence
recommendation.body: Reproduce on Node 24 and collect a redacted full stack plus resolved plugin/package paths before selecting the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the previous guard for the same Feishu dispatch exception and have the strongest direct history signal.
